dataset.description: Generated synthetic financial records representing transactions across different layers.

ground_truth.description: The exact expected state and resolution for a set of related records.

fields.records: List of record IDs involved (e.g., P-123, S-456)
fields.expected_status: Status the system should reach (e.g., EXACT_MATCH, EXCEPTION)
fields.expected_match: List of IDs that should be matched together
fields.expected_root_cause: The true reason for the anomaly (e.g., AMOUNT_MISMATCH_FEE_VARIANCE, NONE)
fields.expected_action: The decision the AI/Policy Engine should make (e.g., AUTO_RESOLVE, ESCALATE, REJECT)
